source_notes: Figure 1c is an illustrative/reference structure, not measured nanocrystal coordinates.

Figure 2/4 temperature-panel assignments and Figure 5 family XRD are not silently joined to one physical vial. Figure 5 caption does not assign solvent or temperature, so no acetone or ODE sample link is asserted.
Figure 6 control links are dotted PL wavelength markers only; full control spectra are outside this main-text figure.
Main p.4 explicitly contrasts protonated Figure 2a with the small uniform deprotonated Figure 4a cubes; do not transfer that morphology to Figure 2a.

SI p.18 Table S4 uses red type for heated complexation. The protonated RT, 50 °C, 120 °C and 150 °C 0–30 s entries used here are black-text entries; no heated complexation or physical aliquot identity is inferred for Figure 2.

evidence_conflicts.topic: Main Methods §2.2.5 gives generic 30 min protonated-acetone stirring, while SI Table S4 gives 10 min for RT and 50 °C rows.
evidence_conflicts.handling: Retain generic operation and sample-specific condition timings separately; mark their discrepancy in both affected sample records.

evidence_conflicts.topic: Main Methods §2.2.6 gives a 0–15 min protonated-ODE family range, while SI Table S4 gives 120 °C 10 min and black-text 150 °C 0–30 s.
evidence_conflicts.handling: Keep the family range distinct from Table S4's temperature-specific entries and exclude red heated-complexation variants from this delta.
